mapper.select:
SELECT ag.auth_group_seq, ag.auth_group_cd, ag.auth_group_nm, ag.auth_group_desc, ag.use_yn FROM adm_auth_group ag WHERE 1=1
AND ( ag.auth_group_nm LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR ag.auth_group_cd LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY ag.auth_group_seq

SELECT m.menu_seq, m.up_menu_seq, m.menu_nm, m.menu_url, m.menu_type_cd, m.icon_class, m.sort_ord, m.use_yn, LEVEL AS tree_lvl, CASE WHEN NVL(aam.use_yn, 'N') = 'Y' THEN NVL(aam.perm_lvl, 0) ELSE 0 END AS perm_lvl, NVL(aam.use_yn, 'N') AS map_use_yn FROM adm_menu_mst m LEFT JOIN adm_auth_menu aam ON aam.auth_group_seq = #{authGroupSeq} AND aam.menu_seq = m.menu_seq WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' START WITH m.up_menu_seq IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR m.menu_seq = m.up_menu_seq ORDER SIBLINGS BY m.sort_ord, m.menu_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adm_auth_menu ( auth_group_seq, menu_seq, perm_lvl, use_yn, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{auth_group_seq}, #{menu_seq}, #{perm_lvl}, #{use_yn}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{created_by}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{updated_by} )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO adm_auth_menu t USING ( SELECT #{auth_group_seq} AS auth_group_seq, #{menu_seq} AS menu_seq, #{perm_lvl} AS perm_lvl, #{use_yn} AS use_yn, #{created_by} AS created_by, #{updated_by} AS updated_by FROM dual ) s ON ( t.auth_group_seq = s.auth_group_seq AND t.menu_seq = s.menu_seq ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.perm_lvl = s.perm_lvl, t.use_yn = s.use_yn, t.updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, t.updated_by = s.updated_by WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( auth_group_seq, menu_seq, perm_lvl, use_yn, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( s.auth_group_seq, s.menu_seq, s.perm_lvl, s.use_yn, SYSTIMESTAMP, s.created_by, SYSTIMESTAMP, s.updated_by )
mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_seq, u.login_id, u.user_nm, u.use_yn FROM adm_user_mst u WHERE u.use_yn = 'Y'
AND ( u.login_id LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_nm LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY u.user_seq

WITH USER_GROUPS AS ( SELECT AGU.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ FROM ADM_AUTH_GROUP_USER AGU WHERE AGU.USER_SEQ = #{userSeq} AND AGU.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION SELECT AGD.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ FROM ADM_AUTH_GROUP_DEPT AGD JOIN ADM_USER_MST U ON U.USER_SEQ = #{userSeq} AND U.DEPT_SEQ = AGD.DEPT_SEQ WHERE AGD.USE_YN = 'Y' ), BASE_PERM AS ( SELECT AAM.MENU_SEQ, MAX(NVL(AAM.PERM_LVL, 0)) AS BASE_PERM_LVL FROM ADM_AUTH_MENU AAM JOIN USER_GROUPS UG ON UG.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ = AAM.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ WHERE AAM.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY AAM.MENU_SEQ ), USER_EX AS ( SELECT AU.MENU_SEQ, MAX(AU.ACCESS_YN) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY COALESCE(AU.UPDATED_AT, AU.CREATED_AT, SYSTIMESTAMP)) AS EX_ACCESS_YN, MAX(NVL(AU.PERM_LVL, 0)) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY COALESCE(AU.UPDATED_AT, AU.CREATED_AT, SYSTIMESTAMP)) AS EX_PERM_LVL FROM ADM_AUTH_USER AU WHERE AU.USER_SEQ = #{userSeq} GROUP BY AU.MENU_SEQ ) SELECT M.MENU_SEQ, M.UP_MENU_SEQ, M.MENU_NM, M.MENU_URL, LEVEL AS TREE_LVL, NVL(BP.BASE_PERM_LVL, 0) AS BASE_PERM_LVL, UE.EX_ACCESS_YN AS EX_ACCESS_YN, NVL(UE.EX_PERM_LVL, 0) AS EX_PERM_LVL FROM ADM_MENU_MST M LEFT JOIN BASE_PERM BP ON BP.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ LEFT JOIN USER_EX UE ON UE.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' START WITH M.UP_MENU_SEQ IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR M.MENU_SEQ = M.UP_MENU_SEQ ORDER SIBLINGS BY M.SORT_ORD, M.MENU_SEQ
mapper.update: MERGE INTO ADM_AUTH_USER T USING ( SELECT #{user_seq} AS USER_SEQ, #{menu_seq} AS MENU_SEQ, #{access_yn} AS ACCESS_YN, #{perm_lvl} AS PERM_LVL, #{created_by} AS CREATED_BY, #{updated_by} AS UPDATED_BY FROM DUAL ) S ON ( T.USER_SEQ = S.USER_SEQ AND T.MENU_SEQ = S.MENU_SEQ ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.ACCESS_YN = S.ACCESS_YN, T.PERM_LVL = S.PERM_LVL, T.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, T.UPDATED_BY = S.UPDATED_BY WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( USER_SEQ, MENU_SEQ, ACCESS_YN, PERM_LVL, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( S.USER_SEQ, S.MENU_SEQ, S.ACCESS_YN, S.PERM_LVL, SYSTIMESTAMP, S.CREATED_BY, SYSTIMESTAMP, S.UPDATED_BY )

UPDATE ADM_USER_MST SET LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = #{login_fail_cnt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LOCK_UNTIL_AT = #{lock_until_at,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, LOCK_YN = #{lock_yn,jdbcType=CHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{updated_by,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE USER_SEQ = #{user_seq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
UPDATE ADM_USER_MST SET LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = 0, LOCK_UNTIL_AT = NULL, LOCK_YN = 'N', UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE USER_SEQ = #{userSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_SEQ, LOGIN_ID, USER_NM, PWD_HASH, NVL(LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, 0) AS LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, NVL(LOCK_YN, 'N') AS LOCK_YN, LOCK_UNTIL_AT, NVL(PWD_RESET_YN, 'N') AS PWD_RESET_YN FROM ADM_USER_MST WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{user_id} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
